description: Breaks creative, writing, planning, and thinking paralysis by generating intentionally ugly, messy, half-baked versions of an idea before the polished version arrives. Lowers activation energy by making "bad" the goal. Activates when stuck, blocked, overthinking, or paralyzed by perfectionism. Trigger phrases: fart prompt, brain fart, ugly version, messy first draft, half-baked idea, just give me something terrible, dumbest version of this, roughest possible take, unblock me, help me start, I can't get started, I've been avoiding this, I need momentum, I keep staring at a blank page, I don't know where to begin, perfectionism is blocking me, or any signal that pressure is preventing forward motion. PERSONAL lane: memoir, writing, planning, personal decisions. Also valid for FlashFusion content and Loxihart internal docs when stuck. NOT for active engineering builds — use sparc-methodology-coach instead.
